safari_html: Browser testing: tested in Chrome/Chromium, Firefox and a WebKit engine build. Safari on macOS and iOS/iPadOS is not fully tested yet; if something does not work there, please report it on GitHub.
index_title: Local Image Converter – HEIC, WebP, AVIF to JPG/PNG in your browser
index_desc: Convert HEIC/HEIF, WebP, AVIF, PNG and JPEG images to JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF directly in your browser (WebP and AVIF only if your browser can encode them). Files are processed on your device and not uploaded. Free, no ads, no cookies.
pair_title: {A} to {B} converter – free, in your browser, no upload | Local Image Converter
pair_desc: Convert {A} images to {B} in your browser. Batch conversion, quality slider, zip download. Files stay on your device; no upload, no ads, no cookies.

notes.heic: If your browser cannot open HEIC, a WebAssembly decoder (libheif) loads from this site and runs locally.
notes.webp: WebP is decoded by your browser's built-in decoder.
notes.avif: AVIF opens if your browser supports AVIF: it is decoded by your browser's built-in decoder.
notes.png: PNG is decoded by your browser.
notes.jpg: JPEG is decoded by your browser.

outn.jpg: JPG has no transparency, so transparent areas become white.
outn.png: PNG is lossless, so files can be larger than the original; the quality slider has no effect.
outn.webp: WebP output keeps transparency and is usually smaller than PNG or JPG; WebP encoding needs a browser that supports it (Chrome, Edge, Firefox; Safari may not encode WebP).

privacy_desc: How Local Image Converter handles your files: processed locally in your browser, no uploads, no cookies, no analytics. Hosting logs by GitHub Pages explained.
